description: A rebuilt SeaQuest faces genetically engineered people, psychic phenomena, alien contact and increasingly strange threats while its younger crew takes on larger roles and Bridger's mission drifts further beyond conventional exploration.

s02e01-02.description: The new SeaQuest responds when genetically engineered life forms revolt, seize a weapons base and threaten war with humanity.

s02e03.description: Aliens answer SeaQuest's earlier message through Darwin, but military officials turn humanity's first-contact opportunity into a confrontation.

s02e04.description: A failed parapsychology experiment drives an underwater colony toward madness, and the same influence begins affecting the arriving SeaQuest crew.

s02e05.description: Shore leave turns into overlapping romantic complications for the crew while Piccolo, Lucas and Dagwood answer an urgent plea from Piccolo's father.

s02e06.description: An underwater anomaly throws SeaQuest 225 years into a devastated future where only two teenagers appear to remain alive.

s02e07.description: A submarine controlled by a computerized copy of Bridger's personality goes rogue, forcing the real captain to outthink a machine modeled on himself.

s02e08.description: A distress call from a horticultural colony brings a seemingly harmless plant aboard SeaQuest, where it mutates into a rapidly escalating threat.

s02e09.description: Brody's mother returns after twenty-two years in cryogenic suspension and immediately becomes the target of an assassin tied to the crew's past.

s02e10.description: Dagwood is accused of murdering his creator during shore leave, leaving Ford and Brody to fight a case built around memories Dagwood does not possess.

s02e11.description: Lucas, Brody, O'Neill and Henderson are trapped in a cavern with too little air for everyone to escape, forcing an unbearable survival lottery.

s02e12.description: An undersea mining operation releases a gigantic prehistoric crocodile and puts Ford's family in the path of the creature.

s02e13.description: Ford discovers evidence of Atlantis, but an ancient golden helmet carries a curse that changes Bridger and Ortiz after they try it on.

s02e14.description: Lucas falls for a woman on shore and considers leaving SeaQuest, unaware that the relationship is part of a plan to seize the vessel.

s02e15.description: A comet dissolves around SeaQuest and seeds the ship with an aggressive alien predator that stalks the disabled vessel.

s02e16.description: A powerful psychic called the Avatar attacks world leaders, forcing Dr. Smith to confront him while governments respond by imprisoning other psychics.

s02e17.description: An escort mission leads Lucas and O'Neill to an ancient pyramid and a rock star speaking in Greek about the return of the sea god Neptune.

s02e18.description: Researchers open an ancient chest at an abandoned mining outpost and unleash what appears to be the force behind the legend of Pandora's Box.

s02e19.description: A master hacker frees Mariah and uses her vendetta against Bridger in a scheme that could destroy SeaQuest and exploit the ocean floor.

s02e20.description: Piccolo and Dagwood begin sharing the same nightmare, leading Dr. Smith to a parapsychology institute whose director is secretly manipulating their dreams.

s02e21.description: After a crash in South America, Piccolo is captured by a dictator whose experimental cloaked life forms have escaped control.

s02e22.description: An alien vessel transports SeaQuest billions of light-years away and drops the crew into a civil war on another world.
